desktop/presentation.bundleRepairBody: The bundled service and desktop files do not match. Repair or reinstall the desktop; your saved work is preserved.
desktop/presentation.addressConflictTitle: Another application is using this address
desktop/presentation.addressConflictBody: This address did not identify an OffGrid workspace. Check the configured service address; no application was stopped.
desktop/presentation.unavailableBody: The service did not respond. Check that it is running and that localhost forwarding is available, then retry.
desktop/presentation.incompatible: A different service is already running
desktop/presentation.intro: Your conversations, knowledge, and agents. On your computer.
desktop/presentation.separateBody: Temporarily uses another local port with separate models and history. Existing data is not copied or changed. The next launch reconnects to the normal workspace.
desktop/presentation.guidance: Your saved work is preserved. Retry, open the existing web workspace, or use a separate desktop workspace.
desktop/presentation.reopen: Applies after you quit and reopen OffGrid
desktop/presentation.actionError: This action could not complete. Retry, or close and reopen OffGrid.
desktop/presentation.reconnectingBody: Your existing service is not ready yet. OffGrid will reconnect automatically when it becomes available. Your workspace stays unchanged.
desktop/presentation.workspaceWrite: Read and edit files in this folder.
desktop/presentation.workspaceCommands: Read/edit files and run trusted project commands with your OS account’s authority. Commands are NOT sandboxed.
desktop/presentation.workspaceLifetime: Access lasts only for this live host session. Stop workspace access or quit OffGrid to revoke it. Revocation does not undo completed changes.
desktop/presentation.chooseUpload: Select one file for this computer task

desktop/folder-trust.remember: Remember this exact folder, account, service and permission level
desktop/folder-trust.title: Remembered folder access

core.guidance.profiles: A profile saves an agent’s model, instructions and allowed resources. Select it in Chat to start work; inspect saved tasks in Activity.
core.knowledge.empty: No documents have been indexed yet.
core.guidance.languageModels: Language models write replies. Larger models often need more memory; file size is not the memory required to run them.
core.guidance.activity: Inspect saved work and its results here. If an action’s outcome is unknown, inspect its target before deciding how to recover.
core.chatStreaming.profileHint: Interactive uses a smaller context allocation. Extended uses the service context and more memory. Switching profiles may reload the model; history is never silently removed.
core.guidance.embeddingModels: Embedding models help find passages in documents. They do not write chat replies.
core.guidance.speechModels: Speech models handle audio. Availability depends on the installed runtime and model.
core.guidance.discovery: Discovery uses the internet. For local models, open Installed. Downloading a model does not verify that it can run on this device.
core.guidance.knowledge: Add documents, wait for indexing, then choose Ask using Knowledge. Indexed means searchable; check a reply’s sources to see what it used.
core.guidance.coldStart: The first response can take longer while the model loads. You can stop waiting with Stop.
core.guidance.serviceOffline: The service is not responding. Check its connection in Settings, then retry. This does not establish whether an earlier action completed.
core.guidance.connectionMeaning: A reachable service only confirms the connection. Models may run locally; discovery and connected tools can use external services.
core.modelSearch.title: Find more models
core.modelSearch.hint: Search public GGUF repositories on Hugging Face. Your search goes online; model sizes are not limited by this catalog.
core.modelSearch.empty: No matching public GGUF repositories. Try a different name.
core.modelSearch.unavailable: Search or file discovery is unavailable. Check internet access and model permissions, then retry.
core.modelSearch.compatibility: Check the model card, license and runtime support before downloading. File size is not RAM/VRAM usage; context needs extra memory. Split weights and projectors are not standalone models. Lists show up to 1,000 repository entries.
core.modelDownload.retained: Downloaded data is kept. Resume to retry without starting over.
core.history.deleteChatsBody: Delete {count} listed conversations and their local drafts? This cannot be undone here. Backups are not erased.
core.history.deleteTasksBody: Remove {count} selected tasks from history? This cannot be undone here. Tool-created files, audit logs and backups are kept.
core.history.partialFailure: {count} items could not be deleted. They may be busy or unavailable. Refresh or retry; deleted items will not be repeated.
core.history.protectedTasks: Completed tasks and interrupted tasks without recovery state can be deleted. Active work, resumable tasks and unresolved tool outcomes remain protected.
core.history.draftProtected: Keep or clear your current draft before reusing a task.
core.agentLive.reconnectHint: The connection is recovering. The task continues on the service; do not submit it again.
core.agentLive.provisional: In progress — not a completed answer
core.agentLive.previewLimit: Preview limit reached. The complete result will appear when the task finishes.
core.chatStreaming.cancelled: Stopped. Your draft is retained. Reload the conversation before retrying if saving had started.
core.chatStreaming.limitReached: Response reached the token limit. Ask to continue or increase the response limit.
core.recovery.draftWarning: Draft could not be saved on this device. Keep this page open until sent.
core.recovery.verifyOutcome: Inspect the tool's target first, then describe what actually happened. This does not rerun the tool.
core.knowledgeSetup.title: Prepare knowledge retrieval
core.knowledgeSetup.body: Knowledge uses an embedding model on the connected service to index and search your documents.
core.agentRuntime.noTasks: No agent tasks have run yet.

i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.title: What should this agent help with?
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.hint: Describe the outcome, preferred style and limits. Tools and context are optional; add only what this work needs.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.0.1: Help me draft and refine clear, useful writing. Ask about the audience when it matters. Preserve my meaning, explain significant edits, and return the draft in Chat unless I explicitly ask you to save or publish it.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.1.1: Help me compare information from the sources I provide or authorize. Cite supporting evidence, distinguish facts from interpretation, and explain disagreements or missing information. Never invent a source or claim verification you have not performed.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.2.1: Explain unfamiliar ideas with clear examples suited to my experience. Start with the main point, check assumptions when needed, and help me work through problems. Answer directly when no tools are needed.

i18n/theme-chooser:themeChooser.hint: Preview a theme, then apply it. Light and dark choices are saved separately.

i18n/voice-setup:copy: Model files and speech runtimes are separate. Re-downloading a model will not fix a missing runtime. Choose an available model, or ask the service administrator to set up its runtime.

i18n/voice-setup:actions.0: No model is installed for this speech feature.

i18n/voice:voiceSilenceText: No speech was detected. Try again or type your message. Your draft is unchanged.

i18n/work-recovery:labels.1: Saved answers and files remain available above. Stopping does not undo completed actions.
i18n/work-recovery:labels.2: Review the last activity before choosing Resume. Continuing uses the saved checkpoint.
i18n/work-recovery:labels.3: This saved task has no resumable checkpoint. Review its activity before starting a new request.

i18n/work-search:workSearchText.scope: Searches authorized conversation names and task requests, not messages or file contents.
i18n/work-search:workSearchText.partial: Some work could not be searched or more matches exist. Refine your search.
i18n/work-search:workSearchText.failed: Saved work could not be searched. Change the query to retry.
i18n/work-search:workSearchText.unavailable: This service supports action search only.
i18n/work-search:workSearchText.hint: Type at least 2 characters to find saved work.

i18n/workflow:inline1.deleteDocument: Delete this document and its index? Existing answers are kept, but this source will no longer be available.
i18n/workflow:inline1.deleteModel: Delete this model file from the service? Saved chats remain. You will need to download the model again to use it.
i18n/workflow:inline1.offlineLibrary: Your documents are retained. Enable knowledge to index files or use them in answers.
i18n/workflow:inline1.sourceTruncated: Preview shortened. This is retained extracted text, not the original file.
i18n/workflow:inline1.timeout: The service took too long to respond. Refresh to check saved state before retrying an operation.
i18n/workflow:inline1.sourceMissing: Source text is unavailable for this document.

i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.documents: Add a file with + in Chat to ask about it beside the document reader. Add it to Knowledge when you want to reuse it in other conversations. Check preparation notices and source citations.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.voice: The microphone dictates into your draft for review. Talk starts a spoken conversation; sending and playback follow the choice you approve. Stop ends listening or playback. Speech needs an installed model and a ready local runtime.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.terminal: The terminal button opens your computer’s shell. OffGrid CLI runs commands; Agent opens profile selection. Switching back to Chat keeps terminal sessions running. Closing a terminal can stop its commands.

i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.defaults: Uses the saved agent configuration. Overrides here do not edit the saved profile.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.chat: Choose an installed model and ask a question. No agent or folder access is needed for conversation. Images require a compatible local vision model.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.agents: Set instructions, model, tools and limits once in Agents. Choose that agent in Chat to reuse its configuration; you do not need to configure each tool again.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.access: Folder and computer access are separate from agent settings. OffGrid asks when work needs access. Grant only what the task needs; use the access controls to stop it.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.returning: Open a conversation to continue, or Activity to inspect saved work. For interrupted work, review its status before resuming. New chat starts separately and does not rerun old actions.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.example: Try: “Explain this idea simply” or “Write a short checklist for my demo.”

i18n/catalog-descriptions.qwen3.5-2b: Small multilingual chat model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image and agent readiness are checked separately.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.smollm3-3b: Text-only multilingual model from Hugging Face. A compact alternative for chat and writing; does not accept images.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.granite-4.1-3b: IBM's compact text model for conversation and document tasks. Text only; tool use requires separate runtime checks.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.lfm2.5-1.2b-instruct: Small text-only download from Liquid AI for everyday conversation. Uses the LFM 1.0 license; review its terms before organizational use.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.gemma-4-e2b-it: Google's compact multimodal model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image readiness is checked separately. The E2B name is not its total memory footprint.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-1b-instruct: Meta's latest compact model, excellent for edge devices
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-3b-instruct: Great balance of size and capability for mobile/edge
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-3.5-mini-instruct: Microsoft's efficient model with strong reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3: Latest Mistral instruct model, excellent for code and reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.hermes-3-llama-3.1-8b: NousResearch's flagship instruct model with strong capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-nemo-instruct-2407: 12B parameter model with excellent instruction following
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-4: Microsoft's latest reasoning model with strong performance
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.3-70b-instruct: Meta's flagship 70B model with exceptional capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.nomic-embed-text-v1: Open-source embedding model, 768 dimensions, long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.bge-m3: Multilingual embedding model, 1024 dimensions, supports long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.speechPackage: Complete speech model package. Speech runtime and qualification are not included.

i18n/computer-experience:copy.networkWarning: Only enable this for a VPN you trust. OffGrid allows this site's fake-DNS routing but cannot verify the VPN's hidden destination. HTTPS verification and site restrictions remain active. No private-network access is granted.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.networkBlocked: Private or reserved address. For a trusted fake-DNS VPN, select Trusted VPN routing and confirm locally. Otherwise check the address. Keep your VPN enabled.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.networkUnavailable: Could not open the page. Check connectivity, HTTPS certificates and redirects to other sites. Other origins remain blocked.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.taskHint: Describe what you want done. OffGrid will show its progress and ask before making changes.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.desktopHelp: Browser assistance runs on your computer. Open the matching OffGrid Desktop app, connect it to this workspace, and enable a browser there. No terminal is needed in the updated desktop build.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.consentBody: OffGrid will open a separate browser for the selected site. It can read that site; changes need approval. No personal profile, saved login, or downloads are used. Access lasts ten minutes for one task. Stop at any time from OffGrid or its tray menu.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.repair: Browser runtime unavailable. Repair the matching desktop package if its files are missing or damaged.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.declined: Permission was declined. No browser session started.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.invalidWebsite: Enter a public HTTPS page URL without login credentials.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.setupStopped: Browser setup stopped. You can try again; no task was started.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.localStoppedDisconnected: The browser is closed locally. OffGrid is unreachable; check the task outcome when it reconnects.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.stopUnconfirmed: Browser shutdown was not confirmed. Close the separate browser manually and inspect the task before trying again.

i18n/voice:voices.unavailable: Speech recognition is not ready. Install a compatible local ASR runtime and model in Models.
i18n/voice:voices.permission: Microphone permission was denied. Allow it for OffGrid and try again.
i18n/voice:voices.unsupported: This app or browser does not support microphone recording.
i18n/voice:voices.failed: Voice input failed. Try again or type your request.
i18n/voice:voices.preparingHint: Generating speech on the connected service. You can stop at any time.
i18n/voice:voices.speechFailed: Audio playback failed. Check the selected speech model and output device.
i18n/voice:voices.speechTimeout: Speech took too long. Playback was stopped; try a shorter passage or a lighter model.
i18n/voice:voices.noSpeech: This response has no readable prose.
i18n/voice:voices.speechUnavailable: No compatible speech voice is ready. Open Models to install a direct-speech model.
i18n/voice:voices.provisionalSpeech: Speaking the draft response. Text is final only when saved.

desktop/presentation.trayBackgroundBody: Closing the window keeps your work running. Open OffGrid from its tray icon, or choose Quit OffGrid in the tray menu to exit.
desktop/presentation.serviceUpdateBody: This workspace is managed separately. Update its service to a compatible build, then retry. Reinstalling the desktop does not update it.
desktop/presentation.bundleRepairBody: The bundled service and desktop files do not match. Repair or reinstall the desktop; your saved work is preserved.
desktop/presentation.addressConflictTitle: Another application is using this address
desktop/presentation.addressConflictBody: This address did not identify an OffGrid workspace. Check the configured service address; no application was stopped.
desktop/presentation.unavailableBody: The service did not respond. Check that it is running and that localhost forwarding is available, then retry.
desktop/presentation.incompatible: A different service is already running
desktop/presentation.intro: Your conversations, knowledge, and agents. On your computer.
desktop/presentation.separateBody: Temporarily uses another local port with separate models and history. Existing data is not copied or changed. The next launch reconnects to the normal workspace.
desktop/presentation.guidance: Your saved work is preserved. Retry, open the existing web workspace, or use a separate desktop workspace.
desktop/presentation.reopen: Applies after you quit and reopen OffGrid
desktop/presentation.actionError: This action could not complete. Retry, or close and reopen OffGrid.
desktop/presentation.reconnectingBody: Your existing service is not ready yet. OffGrid will reconnect automatically when it becomes available. Your workspace stays unchanged.
desktop/presentation.workspaceWrite: Read and edit files in this folder.
desktop/presentation.workspaceCommands: Read/edit files and run trusted project commands with your OS account’s authority. Commands are NOT sandboxed.
desktop/presentation.workspaceLifetime: Access lasts only for this live host session. Stop workspace access or quit OffGrid to revoke it. Revocation does not undo completed changes.
desktop/presentation.chooseUpload: Select one file for this computer task

desktop/folder-trust.remember: Remember this exact folder, account, service and permission level
desktop/folder-trust.title: Remembered folder access
desktop/folder-trust.error: Remembered folder access is unavailable. No permissions were changed.
desktop/folder-trust.notice: Forget removes future automatic approval. Stop workspace access to revoke a connected host.

core.guidance.profiles: A profile saves an agent’s model, instructions and allowed resources. Select it in Chat to start work; inspect saved tasks in Activity.
core.knowledge.empty: No documents have been indexed yet.
core.guidance.languageModels: Language models write replies. Larger models often need more memory; file size is not the memory required to run them.
core.guidance.activity: Inspect saved work and its results here. If an action’s outcome is unknown, inspect its target before deciding how to recover.
core.chatStreaming.profileHint: Interactive uses a smaller context allocation. Extended uses the service context and more memory. Switching profiles may reload the model; history is never silently removed.
core.guidance.embeddingModels: Embedding models help find passages in documents. They do not write chat replies.
core.guidance.speechModels: Speech models handle audio. Availability depends on the installed runtime and model.
core.guidance.discovery: Discovery uses the internet. For local models, open Installed. Downloading a model does not verify that it can run on this device.
core.guidance.knowledge: Add documents, wait for indexing, then choose Ask using Knowledge. Indexed means searchable; check a reply’s sources to see what it used.
core.guidance.coldStart: The first response can take longer while the model loads. You can stop waiting with Stop.
core.guidance.serviceOffline: The service is not responding. Check its connection in Settings, then retry. This does not establish whether an earlier action completed.
core.guidance.connectionMeaning: A reachable service only confirms the connection. Models may run locally; discovery and connected tools can use external services.
core.modelSearch.title: Find more models
core.modelSearch.hint: Search public GGUF repositories on Hugging Face. Your search goes online; model sizes are not limited by this catalog.
core.modelSearch.empty: No matching public GGUF repositories. Try a different name.
core.modelSearch.unavailable: Search or file discovery is unavailable. Check internet access and model permissions, then retry.
core.modelSearch.compatibility: Check the model card, license and runtime support before downloading. File size is not RAM/VRAM usage; context needs extra memory. Split weights and projectors are not standalone models. Lists show up to 1,000 repository entries.
core.modelDownload.retained: Downloaded data is kept. Resume to retry without starting over.
core.history.deleteChatsBody: Delete {count} listed conversations and their local drafts? This cannot be undone here. Backups are not erased.
core.history.deleteTasksBody: Remove {count} selected tasks from history? This cannot be undone here. Tool-created files, audit logs and backups are kept.
core.history.partialFailure: {count} items could not be deleted. They may be busy or unavailable. Refresh or retry; deleted items will not be repeated.
core.history.protectedTasks: Completed tasks and interrupted tasks without recovery state can be deleted. Active work, resumable tasks and unresolved tool outcomes remain protected.
core.history.draftProtected: Keep or clear your current draft before reusing a task.
core.agentLive.reconnectHint: The connection is recovering. The task continues on the service; do not submit it again.
core.agentLive.provisional: In progress — not a completed answer
core.agentLive.previewLimit: Preview limit reached. The complete result will appear when the task finishes.
core.chatStreaming.cancelled: Stopped. Your draft is retained. Reload the conversation before retrying if saving had started.
core.chatStreaming.limitReached: Response reached the token limit. Ask to continue or increase the response limit.
core.recovery.draftWarning: Draft could not be saved on this device. Keep this page open until sent.
core.recovery.verifyOutcome: Inspect the tool's target first, then describe what actually happened. This does not rerun the tool.
core.knowledgeSetup.title: Prepare knowledge retrieval
core.knowledgeSetup.body: Knowledge uses an embedding model on the connected service to index and search your documents.
core.agentRuntime.noTasks: No agent tasks have run yet.
core.agentRuntime.externalProvidersBody: Connect Hermes and OpenClaw through first-party OffGrid provider plugins.

core.chat.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

core.onboarding.body: Set up a chat model, then get a reply to finish setup. Your workspace is stored on the connected OffGrid service.
core.onboarding.modelHint: Download a chat model to begin working.

i18n/workspace-management:labels.4: Searches the permitted knowledge base, not just one selected document. Your draft is preserved; nothing is sent until you choose Send.

i18n/workspace-audit:libraryScope: Add documents here to reuse them across conversations. Files attached in Chat stay with that conversation; they are not added to this library.

i18n/agent-schedules:rows.22: Scheduling is unavailable on this service.
i18n/agent-schedules:rows.24: Computer access is unavailable. Trusted local commands are not sandboxed. Disabling blocks new actions; work already sent may still need reconciliation.

i18n/activity-empty:copy.5: Earlier work is available in Archived.

i18n/settings-navigation:settingsNavigat.descriptions.1: Response limits apply to Chat on this connection. Agent profiles keep their own model and limits.
i18n/settings-navigation:settingsNavigat.descriptions.4: Review access and where your workspace is stored.
i18n/settings-navigation:settingsNavigat.descriptions.2: Choose recognition and playback models. Listening and automatic playback stay off until you start them in Chat.
i18n/settings-navigation:settingsNavigat.descriptions.3: Text size, spacing, cursor and scrollback are managed in Terminal display (Aa).
i18n/settings-navigation:settingsNavigat.browser: Terminal display settings are available in the OffGrid desktop app.
i18n/settings-navigation:settingsNavigat.descriptions.5: Connection details and diagnostics. These values describe the service; they do not change its configuration.

i18n/personalization:personalization.9: This device only. Conversations, models and permissions are unchanged.
i18n/personalization:personalization.10: Applied for this session; could not save.

i18n/response-budget:responseBudgetHint: This limits one answer, not the conversation. History, document excerpts and the answer share the model’s context. A lower response limit leaves more room for questions and sources.

i18n/agent-context:agentContextText.review: Review draft as a new skill

i18n/agent-profiles:agentProfilesText.empty: Create an agent for the work you do often.

i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.title: What should this agent help with?
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.hint: Describe the outcome, preferred style and limits. Tools and context are optional; add only what this work needs.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.0.1: Help me draft and refine clear, useful writing. Ask about the audience when it matters. Preserve my meaning, explain significant edits, and return the draft in Chat unless I explicitly ask you to save or publish it.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.1.1: Help me compare information from the sources I provide or authorize. Cite supporting evidence, distinguish facts from interpretation, and explain disagreements or missing information. Never invent a source or claim verification you have not performed.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.2.1: Explain unfamiliar ideas with clear examples suited to my experience. Start with the main point, check assumptions when needed, and help me work through problems. Answer directly when no tools are needed.

i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.documents: Add a file with + in Chat to ask about it beside the document reader. Add it to Knowledge when you want to reuse it in other conversations. Check preparation notices and source citations.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.voice: The microphone dictates into your draft for review. Talk starts a spoken conversation; sending and playback follow the choice you approve. Stop ends listening or playback. Speech needs an installed model and a ready local runtime.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.terminal: The terminal button opens your computer’s shell. OffGrid CLI runs commands; Agent opens profile selection. Switching back to Chat keeps terminal sessions running. Closing a terminal can stop its commands.

i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.defaults: Uses the saved agent configuration. Overrides here do not edit the saved profile.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.chat: Choose an installed model and ask a question. No agent or folder access is needed for conversation. Images require a compatible local vision model.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.agents: Set instructions, model, tools and limits once in Agents. Choose that agent in Chat to reuse its configuration; you do not need to configure each tool again.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.access: Folder and computer access are separate from agent settings. OffGrid asks when work needs access. Grant only what the task needs; use the access controls to stop it.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.returning: Open a conversation to continue, or Activity to inspect saved work. For interrupted work, review its status before resuming. New chat starts separately and does not rerun old actions.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.example: Try: “Explain this idea simply” or “Write a short checklist for my demo.”

i18n/catalog-descriptions.qwen3.5-2b: Small multilingual chat model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image and agent readiness are checked separately.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.smollm3-3b: Text-only multilingual model from Hugging Face. A compact alternative for chat and writing; does not accept images.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.granite-4.1-3b: IBM's compact text model for conversation and document tasks. Text only; tool use requires separate runtime checks.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.lfm2.5-1.2b-instruct: Small text-only download from Liquid AI for everyday conversation. Uses the LFM 1.0 license; review its terms before organizational use.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.gemma-4-e2b-it: Google's compact multimodal model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image readiness is checked separately. The E2B name is not its total memory footprint.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-1b-instruct: Meta's latest compact model, excellent for edge devices
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-3b-instruct: Great balance of size and capability for mobile/edge
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-3.5-mini-instruct: Microsoft's efficient model with strong reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3: Latest Mistral instruct model, excellent for code and reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.hermes-3-llama-3.1-8b: NousResearch's flagship instruct model with strong capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-nemo-instruct-2407: 12B parameter model with excellent instruction following
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-4: Microsoft's latest reasoning model with strong performance
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.3-70b-instruct: Meta's flagship 70B model with exceptional capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.nomic-embed-text-v1: Open-source embedding model, 768 dimensions, long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.bge-m3: Multilingual embedding model, 1024 dimensions, supports long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.speechPackage: Complete speech model package. Speech runtime and qualification are not included.

core.guidance.profiles: A profile saves an agent’s model, instructions and allowed resources. Select it in Chat to start work; inspect saved tasks in Activity.
core.knowledge.empty: No documents have been indexed yet.
core.guidance.languageModels: Language models write replies. Larger models often need more memory; file size is not the memory required to run them.
core.guidance.activity: Inspect saved work and its results here. If an action’s outcome is unknown, inspect its target before deciding how to recover.
core.chatStreaming.profileHint: Interactive uses a smaller context allocation. Extended uses the service context and more memory. Switching profiles may reload the model; history is never silently removed.
core.guidance.embeddingModels: Embedding models help find passages in documents. They do not write chat replies.
core.guidance.speechModels: Speech models handle audio. Availability depends on the installed runtime and model.
core.guidance.discovery: Discovery uses the internet. For local models, open Installed. Downloading a model does not verify that it can run on this device.
core.guidance.knowledge: Add documents, wait for indexing, then choose Ask using Knowledge. Indexed means searchable; check a reply’s sources to see what it used.
core.guidance.coldStart: The first response can take longer while the model loads. You can stop waiting with Stop.
core.guidance.serviceOffline: The service is not responding. Check its connection in Settings, then retry. This does not establish whether an earlier action completed.
core.guidance.connectionMeaning: A reachable service only confirms the connection. Models may run locally; discovery and connected tools can use external services.

core.history.draftProtected: Keep or clear your current draft before reusing a task.

core.agentLive.provisional: In progress — not a completed answer
core.agentLive.previewLimit: Preview limit reached. The complete result will appear when the task finishes.

i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.title: What should this agent help with?
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.hint: Describe the outcome, preferred style and limits. Tools and context are optional; add only what this work needs.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.0.1: Help me draft and refine clear, useful writing. Ask about the audience when it matters. Preserve my meaning, explain significant edits, and return the draft in Chat unless I explicitly ask you to save or publish it.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.1.1: Help me compare information from the sources I provide or authorize. Cite supporting evidence, distinguish facts from interpretation, and explain disagreements or missing information. Never invent a source or claim verification you have not performed.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.2.1: Explain unfamiliar ideas with clear examples suited to my experience. Start with the main point, check assumptions when needed, and help me work through problems. Answer directly when no tools are needed.

i18n/known-work:knownWorkText.title: Known work
i18n/known-work:knownWorkText.scope: Recent conversations opened here and active tasks. This is not a count of all workspace activity.

i18n/login-context:loginContext.account: Use an account created on this service, not your computer password.

i18n/model-comparison:modelComparison.hint: Choose up to three. These are catalog estimates, not a test of your computer. Memory use also depends on context and runtime.

i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.documents: Add a file with + in Chat to ask about it beside the document reader. Add it to Knowledge when you want to reuse it in other conversations. Check preparation notices and source citations.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.voice: The microphone dictates into your draft for review. Talk starts a spoken conversation; sending and playback follow the choice you approve. Stop ends listening or playback. Speech needs an installed model and a ready local runtime.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.terminal: The terminal button opens your computer’s shell. OffGrid CLI runs commands; Agent opens profile selection. Switching back to Chat keeps terminal sessions running. Closing a terminal can stop its commands.

i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.defaults: Uses the saved agent configuration. Overrides here do not edit the saved profile.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.chat: Choose an installed model and ask a question. No agent or folder access is needed for conversation. Images require a compatible local vision model.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.agents: Set instructions, model, tools and limits once in Agents. Choose that agent in Chat to reuse its configuration; you do not need to configure each tool again.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.access: Folder and computer access are separate from agent settings. OffGrid asks when work needs access. Grant only what the task needs; use the access controls to stop it.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.returning: Open a conversation to continue, or Activity to inspect saved work. For interrupted work, review its status before resuming. New chat starts separately and does not rerun old actions.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.example: Try: “Explain this idea simply” or “Write a short checklist for my demo.”

i18n/catalog-descriptions.qwen3.5-2b: Small multilingual chat model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image and agent readiness are checked separately.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.smollm3-3b: Text-only multilingual model from Hugging Face. A compact alternative for chat and writing; does not accept images.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.granite-4.1-3b: IBM's compact text model for conversation and document tasks. Text only; tool use requires separate runtime checks.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.lfm2.5-1.2b-instruct: Small text-only download from Liquid AI for everyday conversation. Uses the LFM 1.0 license; review its terms before organizational use.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.gemma-4-e2b-it: Google's compact multimodal model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image readiness is checked separately. The E2B name is not its total memory footprint.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-1b-instruct: Meta's latest compact model, excellent for edge devices
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-3b-instruct: Great balance of size and capability for mobile/edge
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-3.5-mini-instruct: Microsoft's efficient model with strong reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3: Latest Mistral instruct model, excellent for code and reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.hermes-3-llama-3.1-8b: NousResearch's flagship instruct model with strong capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-nemo-instruct-2407: 12B parameter model with excellent instruction following
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-4: Microsoft's latest reasoning model with strong performance
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.3-70b-instruct: Meta's flagship 70B model with exceptional capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.nomic-embed-text-v1: Open-source embedding model, 768 dimensions, long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.bge-m3: Multilingual embedding model, 1024 dimensions, supports long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.speechPackage: Complete speech model package. Speech runtime and qualification are not included.

i18n/computer-experience:copy.networkWarning: Only enable this for a VPN you trust. OffGrid allows this site's fake-DNS routing but cannot verify the VPN's hidden destination. HTTPS verification and site restrictions remain active. No private-network access is granted.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.networkBlocked: Private or reserved address. For a trusted fake-DNS VPN, select Trusted VPN routing and confirm locally. Otherwise check the address. Keep your VPN enabled.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.networkUnavailable: Could not open the page. Check connectivity, HTTPS certificates and redirects to other sites. Other origins remain blocked.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.taskHint: Describe what you want done. OffGrid will show its progress and ask before making changes.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.desktopHelp: Browser assistance runs on your computer. Open the matching OffGrid Desktop app, connect it to this workspace, and enable a browser there. No terminal is needed in the updated desktop build.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.consentBody: OffGrid will open a separate browser for the selected site. It can read that site; changes need approval. No personal profile, saved login, or downloads are used. Access lasts ten minutes for one task. Stop at any time from OffGrid or its tray menu.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.repair: Browser runtime unavailable. Repair the matching desktop package if its files are missing or damaged.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.declined: Permission was declined. No browser session started.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.invalidWebsite: Enter a public HTTPS page URL without login credentials.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.setupStopped: Browser setup stopped. You can try again; no task was started.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.localStoppedDisconnected: The browser is closed locally. OffGrid is unreachable; check the task outcome when it reconnects.
i18n/computer-experience:copy.stopUnconfirmed: Browser shutdown was not confirmed. Close the separate browser manually and inspect the task before trying again.

i18n/voice:voices.unavailable: Speech recognition is not ready. Install a compatible local ASR runtime and model in Models.
i18n/voice:voices.permission: Microphone permission was denied. Allow it for OffGrid and try again.
i18n/voice:voices.unsupported: This app or browser does not support microphone recording.
i18n/voice:voices.failed: Voice input failed. Try again or type your request.
i18n/voice:voices.preparingHint: Generating speech on the connected service. You can stop at any time.
i18n/voice:voices.speechFailed: Audio playback failed. Check the selected speech model and output device.
i18n/voice:voices.speechTimeout: Speech took too long. Playback was stopped; try a shorter passage or a lighter model.
i18n/voice:voices.noSpeech: This response has no readable prose.
i18n/voice:voices.speechUnavailable: No compatible speech voice is ready. Open Models to install a direct-speech model.
i18n/voice:voices.provisionalSpeech: Speaking the draft response. Text is final only when saved.

desktop/presentation.trayBackgroundBody: Closing the window keeps your work running. Open OffGrid from its tray icon, or choose Quit OffGrid in the tray menu to exit.
desktop/presentation.serviceUpdateBody: This workspace is managed separately. Update its service to a compatible build, then retry. Reinstalling the desktop does not update it.
desktop/presentation.bundleRepairBody: The bundled service and desktop files do not match. Repair or reinstall the desktop; your saved work is preserved.
desktop/presentation.addressConflictTitle: Another application is using this address
desktop/presentation.addressConflictBody: This address did not identify an OffGrid workspace. Check the configured service address; no application was stopped.
desktop/presentation.unavailableBody: The service did not respond. Check that it is running and that localhost forwarding is available, then retry.
desktop/presentation.incompatible: A different service is already running
desktop/presentation.intro: Your conversations, knowledge, and agents. On your computer.
desktop/presentation.separateBody: Temporarily uses another local port with separate models and history. Existing data is not copied or changed. The next launch reconnects to the normal workspace.
desktop/presentation.guidance: Your saved work is preserved. Retry, open the existing web workspace, or use a separate desktop workspace.
desktop/presentation.reopen: Applies after you quit and reopen OffGrid
desktop/presentation.actionError: This action could not complete. Retry, or close and reopen OffGrid.
desktop/presentation.reconnectingBody: Your existing service is not ready yet. OffGrid will reconnect automatically when it becomes available. Your workspace stays unchanged.
desktop/presentation.workspaceWrite: Read and edit files in this folder.
desktop/presentation.workspaceCommands: Read/edit files and run trusted project commands with your OS account’s authority. Commands are NOT sandboxed.
desktop/presentation.workspaceLifetime: Access lasts only for this live host session. Stop workspace access or quit OffGrid to revoke it. Revocation does not undo completed changes.
desktop/presentation.chooseUpload: Select one file for this computer task

desktop/folder-trust.remember: Remember this exact folder, account, service and permission level
desktop/folder-trust.title: Remembered folder access
desktop/folder-trust.error: Remembered folder access is unavailable. No permissions were changed.
desktop/folder-trust.notice: Forget removes future automatic approval. Stop workspace access to revoke a connected host.

core.guidance.profiles: A profile saves an agent’s model, instructions and allowed resources. Select it in Chat to start work; inspect saved tasks in Activity.
core.knowledge.empty: No documents have been indexed yet.
core.guidance.languageModels: Language models write replies. Larger models often need more memory; file size is not the memory required to run them.
core.guidance.activity: Inspect saved work and its results here. If an action’s outcome is unknown, inspect its target before deciding how to recover.
core.chatStreaming.profileHint: Interactive uses a smaller context allocation. Extended uses the service context and more memory. Switching profiles may reload the model; history is never silently removed.
core.guidance.embeddingModels: Embedding models help find passages in documents. They do not write chat replies.
core.guidance.speechModels: Speech models handle audio. Availability depends on the installed runtime and model.
core.guidance.discovery: Discovery uses the internet. For local models, open Installed. Downloading a model does not verify that it can run on this device.
core.guidance.knowledge: Add documents, wait for indexing, then choose Ask using Knowledge. Indexed means searchable; check a reply’s sources to see what it used.
core.guidance.coldStart: The first response can take longer while the model loads. You can stop waiting with Stop.
core.guidance.serviceOffline: The service is not responding. Check its connection in Settings, then retry. This does not establish whether an earlier action completed.
core.guidance.connectionMeaning: A reachable service only confirms the connection. Models may run locally; discovery and connected tools can use external services.
core.modelSearch.title: Find more models
core.modelSearch.hint: Search public GGUF repositories on Hugging Face. Your search goes online; model sizes are not limited by this catalog.
core.modelSearch.empty: No matching public GGUF repositories. Try a different name.
core.modelSearch.unavailable: Search or file discovery is unavailable. Check internet access and model permissions, then retry.
core.modelSearch.compatibility: Check the model card, license and runtime support before downloading. File size is not RAM/VRAM usage; context needs extra memory. Split weights and projectors are not standalone models. Lists show up to 1,000 repository entries.
core.modelDownload.retained: Downloaded data is kept. Resume to retry without starting over.
core.history.deleteChatsBody: Delete {count} listed conversations and their local drafts? This cannot be undone here. Backups are not erased.
core.history.deleteTasksBody: Remove {count} selected tasks from history? This cannot be undone here. Tool-created files, audit logs and backups are kept.
core.history.partialFailure: {count} items could not be deleted. They may be busy or unavailable. Refresh or retry; deleted items will not be repeated.
core.history.protectedTasks: Completed tasks and interrupted tasks without recovery state can be deleted. Active work, resumable tasks and unresolved tool outcomes remain protected.
core.history.draftProtected: Keep or clear your current draft before reusing a task.
core.agentLive.reconnectHint: The connection is recovering. The task continues on the service; do not submit it again.
core.agentLive.provisional: In progress — not a completed answer
core.agentLive.previewLimit: Preview limit reached. The complete result will appear when the task finishes.
core.chatStreaming.cancelled: Stopped. Your draft is retained. Reload the conversation before retrying if saving had started.
core.chatStreaming.limitReached: Response reached the token limit. Ask to continue or increase the response limit.
core.recovery.draftWarning: Draft could not be saved on this device. Keep this page open until sent.
core.recovery.verifyOutcome: Inspect the tool's target first, then describe what actually happened. This does not rerun the tool.

i18n/workspace-management:labels.4: Searches the permitted knowledge base, not just one selected document. Your draft is preserved; nothing is sent until you choose Send.

i18n/model-acquisition:modelAcquisition.runtime: Installed package; the matching local speech runtime adapter is not available in this build yet.

i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.title: What should this agent help with?
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.hint: Describe the outcome, preferred style and limits. Tools and context are optional; add only what this work needs.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.0.1: Help me draft and refine clear, useful writing. Ask about the audience when it matters. Preserve my meaning, explain significant edits, and return the draft in Chat unless I explicitly ask you to save or publish it.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.1.1: Help me compare information from the sources I provide or authorize. Cite supporting evidence, distinguish facts from interpretation, and explain disagreements or missing information. Never invent a source or claim verification you have not performed.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.2.1: Explain unfamiliar ideas with clear examples suited to my experience. Start with the main point, check assumptions when needed, and help me work through problems. Answer directly when no tools are needed.

i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.documents: Add a file with + in Chat to ask about it beside the document reader. Add it to Knowledge when you want to reuse it in other conversations. Check preparation notices and source citations.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.voice: The microphone dictates into your draft for review. Talk starts a spoken conversation; sending and playback follow the choice you approve. Stop ends listening or playback. Speech needs an installed model and a ready local runtime.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.terminal: The terminal button opens your computer’s shell. OffGrid CLI runs commands; Agent opens profile selection. Switching back to Chat keeps terminal sessions running. Closing a terminal can stop its commands.

i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.defaults: Uses the saved agent configuration. Overrides here do not edit the saved profile.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.chat: Choose an installed model and ask a question. No agent or folder access is needed for conversation. Images require a compatible local vision model.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.agents: Set instructions, model, tools and limits once in Agents. Choose that agent in Chat to reuse its configuration; you do not need to configure each tool again.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.access: Folder and computer access are separate from agent settings. OffGrid asks when work needs access. Grant only what the task needs; use the access controls to stop it.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.returning: Open a conversation to continue, or Activity to inspect saved work. For interrupted work, review its status before resuming. New chat starts separately and does not rerun old actions.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.example: Try: “Explain this idea simply” or “Write a short checklist for my demo.”

i18n/catalog-descriptions.qwen3.5-2b: Small multilingual chat model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image and agent readiness are checked separately.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.smollm3-3b: Text-only multilingual model from Hugging Face. A compact alternative for chat and writing; does not accept images.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.granite-4.1-3b: IBM's compact text model for conversation and document tasks. Text only; tool use requires separate runtime checks.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.lfm2.5-1.2b-instruct: Small text-only download from Liquid AI for everyday conversation. Uses the LFM 1.0 license; review its terms before organizational use.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.gemma-4-e2b-it: Google's compact multimodal model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image readiness is checked separately. The E2B name is not its total memory footprint.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-1b-instruct: Meta's latest compact model, excellent for edge devices
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-3b-instruct: Great balance of size and capability for mobile/edge
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-3.5-mini-instruct: Microsoft's efficient model with strong reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3: Latest Mistral instruct model, excellent for code and reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.hermes-3-llama-3.1-8b: NousResearch's flagship instruct model with strong capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-nemo-instruct-2407: 12B parameter model with excellent instruction following
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-4: Microsoft's latest reasoning model with strong performance
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.3-70b-instruct: Meta's flagship 70B model with exceptional capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.nomic-embed-text-v1: Open-source embedding model, 768 dimensions, long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.bge-m3: Multilingual embedding model, 1024 dimensions, supports long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.speechPackage: Complete speech model package. Speech runtime and qualification are not included.

i18n/computer-experience:copy.stopUnconfirmed: Browser shutdown was not confirmed. Close the separate browser manually and inspect the task before trying again.

core.guidance.profiles: A profile saves an agent’s model, instructions and allowed resources. Select it in Chat to start work; inspect saved tasks in Activity.
core.knowledge.empty: No documents have been indexed yet.
core.guidance.languageModels: Language models write replies. Larger models often need more memory; file size is not the memory required to run them.
core.guidance.activity: Inspect saved work and its results here. If an action’s outcome is unknown, inspect its target before deciding how to recover.
core.chatStreaming.profileHint: Interactive uses a smaller context allocation. Extended uses the service context and more memory. Switching profiles may reload the model; history is never silently removed.
core.guidance.embeddingModels: Embedding models help find passages in documents. They do not write chat replies.
core.guidance.speechModels: Speech models handle audio. Availability depends on the installed runtime and model.
core.guidance.discovery: Discovery uses the internet. For local models, open Installed. Downloading a model does not verify that it can run on this device.
core.guidance.knowledge: Add documents, wait for indexing, then choose Ask using Knowledge. Indexed means searchable; check a reply’s sources to see what it used.
core.guidance.coldStart: The first response can take longer while the model loads. You can stop waiting with Stop.
core.guidance.serviceOffline: The service is not responding. Check its connection in Settings, then retry. This does not establish whether an earlier action completed.
core.guidance.connectionMeaning: A reachable service only confirms the connection. Models may run locally; discovery and connected tools can use external services.
core.modelSearch.title: Find more models

core.modelDownload.retained: Downloaded data is kept. Resume to retry without starting over.

core.history.protectedTasks: Completed tasks and interrupted tasks without recovery state can be deleted. Active work, resumable tasks and unresolved tool outcomes remain protected.
core.history.draftProtected: Keep or clear your current draft before reusing a task.

core.agentLive.provisional: In progress — not a completed answer
core.agentLive.previewLimit: Preview limit reached. The complete result will appear when the task finishes.

core.chatStreaming.limitReached: Response reached the token limit. Ask to continue or increase the response limit.
core.recovery.draftWarning: Draft could not be saved on this device. Keep this page open until sent.
core.recovery.verifyOutcome: Inspect the tool's target first, then describe what actually happened. This does not rerun the tool.

i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.title: What should this agent help with?
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.hint: Describe the outcome, preferred style and limits. Tools and context are optional; add only what this work needs.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.0.1: Help me draft and refine clear, useful writing. Ask about the audience when it matters. Preserve my meaning, explain significant edits, and return the draft in Chat unless I explicitly ask you to save or publish it.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.1.1: Help me compare information from the sources I provide or authorize. Cite supporting evidence, distinguish facts from interpretation, and explain disagreements or missing information. Never invent a source or claim verification you have not performed.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.2.1: Explain unfamiliar ideas with clear examples suited to my experience. Start with the main point, check assumptions when needed, and help me work through problems. Answer directly when no tools are needed.

i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.documents: Add a file with + in Chat to ask about it beside the document reader. Add it to Knowledge when you want to reuse it in other conversations. Check preparation notices and source citations.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.voice: The microphone dictates into your draft for review. Talk starts a spoken conversation; sending and playback follow the choice you approve. Stop ends listening or playback. Speech needs an installed model and a ready local runtime.
i18n/workspace-help-topics:helpTopics.terminal: The terminal button opens your computer’s shell. OffGrid CLI runs commands; Agent opens profile selection. Switching back to Chat keeps terminal sessions running. Closing a terminal can stop its commands.

i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.defaults: Uses the saved agent configuration. Overrides here do not edit the saved profile.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.chat: Choose an installed model and ask a question. No agent or folder access is needed for conversation. Images require a compatible local vision model.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.agents: Set instructions, model, tools and limits once in Agents. Choose that agent in Chat to reuse its configuration; you do not need to configure each tool again.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.access: Folder and computer access are separate from agent settings. OffGrid asks when work needs access. Grant only what the task needs; use the access controls to stop it.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.returning: Open a conversation to continue, or Activity to inspect saved work. For interrupted work, review its status before resuming. New chat starts separately and does not rerun old actions.
i18n/workspace-help:workspaceHelp.example: Try: “Explain this idea simply” or “Write a short checklist for my demo.”

i18n/catalog-descriptions.qwen3.5-2b: Small multilingual chat model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image and agent readiness are checked separately.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.smollm3-3b: Text-only multilingual model from Hugging Face. A compact alternative for chat and writing; does not accept images.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.granite-4.1-3b: IBM's compact text model for conversation and document tasks. Text only; tool use requires separate runtime checks.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.lfm2.5-1.2b-instruct: Small text-only download from Liquid AI for everyday conversation. Uses the LFM 1.0 license; review its terms before organizational use.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.gemma-4-e2b-it: Google's compact multimodal model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image readiness is checked separately. The E2B name is not its total memory footprint.
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-1b-instruct: Meta's latest compact model, excellent for edge devices
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.2-3b-instruct: Great balance of size and capability for mobile/edge
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-3.5-mini-instruct: Microsoft's efficient model with strong reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3: Latest Mistral instruct model, excellent for code and reasoning
i18n/catalog-descriptions.hermes-3-llama-3.1-8b: NousResearch's flagship instruct model with strong capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.mistral-nemo-instruct-2407: 12B parameter model with excellent instruction following
i18n/catalog-descriptions.phi-4: Microsoft's latest reasoning model with strong performance
i18n/catalog-descriptions.llama-3.3-70b-instruct: Meta's flagship 70B model with exceptional capabilities
i18n/catalog-descriptions.nomic-embed-text-v1: Open-source embedding model, 768 dimensions, long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.bge-m3: Multilingual embedding model, 1024 dimensions, supports long context
i18n/catalog-descriptions.speechPackage: Complete speech model package. Speech runtime and qualification are not included.

i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.title: What should this agent help with?
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.hint: Describe the outcome, preferred style and limits. Tools and context are optional; add only what this work needs.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.0.1: Help me draft and refine clear, useful writing. Ask about the audience when it matters. Preserve my meaning, explain significant edits, and return the draft in Chat unless I explicitly ask you to save or publish it.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.1.1: Help me compare information from the sources I provide or authorize. Cite supporting evidence, distinguish facts from interpretation, and explain disagreements or missing information. Never invent a source or claim verification you have not performed.
i18n/agent-purpose:agentPurpose.options.2.1: Explain unfamiliar ideas with clear examples suited to my experience. Start with the main point, check assumptions when needed, and help me work through problems. Answer directly when no tools are needed.
